desc: After ticket 201 preserves one complete modern RTKit crashlog, symbolize and annotate it against the exact paired 25F84 ANS firmware and the host nvme-apple call path. Grounding: NEXT_STEPS §3 and ticket 201's Ccst/CasC/Crtk/Ccdp capture contract. Resolve every firmware PC that is covered by the hashed image, correlate assert 7454 and hardware status bit 2 with the raw error registers and queue state, and produce a decision table for the already-approved threaded-IRQ discriminator 210 and m1n1 admin-traffic test 195. Record unknowns explicitly; do not infer from silence or request any physical-memory read. Offline only.
